sharing.reading: Reading where the task list lives…

connect.title: Connect a server
connect.lead: Your team's own Orchester server, by its address. This computer connects to it once; then each of your projects on it is linked to a checkout here.

address.title: Address
address.label: Server address
address.hint: Ask whoever runs the server for its address. An invite by email fills it in for you.
address.nothing: Nothing answered at {{address}}. Check the address, and that this computer is on your team's network.
address.notOrchester: {{address}} answered, but it isn't an Orchester server. The address usually starts with orchester. or has a port, like :8740.
address.plain: This address isn't encrypted: allow plain HTTP for it first.

plain.title: This address isn't encrypted
plain.body: Anyone on the network can read what goes to it, and nothing proves it's your server. Use it only on a network that's yours.

setup.title: This server has no admin yet
setup.body: Whoever runs it sets it up in the browser, with the setup code from its console. Then connect again.

system.title: Your system trusts {{server}}'s certificate
system.body: It's issued by a public authority, so there's no check code to compare. Orchester uses your system's trust for this server.

already.title: You're already connected to {{server}}
already.body: To work on another of its projects, link that project's checkout from Project settings › Sharing, or accept its invite.

compare.title: Compare the check code
compare.lead: {{server}} made its own certificate. Before Orchester trusts it, make sure it's the one your team runs: compare this code with the one the server printed to its console, or ask its admin (Server admin › Settings).
compare.person: Only you can confirm this. From now on Orchester accepts exactly this certificate from {{server}}, and stops if it ever changes.
compare.later: For a server that made its own certificate.
compare.mismatchBody: A different code means this isn't the server your team runs, or something sits between you and it. Nothing was sent. Tell its admin.

join.title: Join
join.later: With your Orchester account, or with an invite code.
join.accountBody: You're signed in as {{email}}. For an invite by email, or a server you're already on.
join.accountSignedOut: For an invite by email, or a server you're already on.
join.accountUnavailable: Sign in to Orchester Cloud first, in Settings › Orchester.
join.codeBody: 8 characters from whoever invited you. Works without the internet.

code.label: Invite code
code.hint: Read without regard to case or the hyphen.
code.invalid: That code isn't right, or it was used or has expired: codes work once, for a limited time. Check it with whoever made it.
code.rateLimited: Too many wrong codes from this computer. Try again in {{minutes}} min.

username.title: Your username there
username.label: Username
username.name: Your name
username.nameHint: Teammates see it next to your work.
username.taken: That username is taken there. Choose another.
username.needed: This code makes a new account: choose a username and your name.

joined.title: Connected to {{server}} as {{username}}
joined.body: Pick the project to join there: Link a checkout… beside it opens the join review.

connect.notInvitedBody: Ask someone there to invite you to their project. The invite reaches you here and brings you straight in.
connect.notInvited: The server has no place for your Orchester account yet. Ask someone there to invite you.
connect.notInvitedServer: {{server}} has no place for your Orchester account. Join with a code, or ask for an invite.
connect.cloudOff: This server doesn't accept Orchester Cloud sign-ins now. Join with a code instead.
connect.keySetStale: The server's copy of Orchester Cloud's keys is out of date. Try again, or join with a code.
connect.approvalRefused: The server refused this computer. If you didn't expect this, ask an admin of the server.
connect.invalidIdentity: The server didn't accept your Orchester Cloud identity. Try again.
connect.twoFactorOff: Entering a code needs two-factor authentication on your Orchester Cloud account. Turn it on under Security on the cloud's Account page, then sign out here and sign in again with your code.
connect.twoFactorSession: Entering a code needs this computer signed in to Orchester Cloud with your two-factor code. Sign out in Settings › Orchester and sign in again with your code.
connect.twoFactorUnverifiable: This server can't check two-factor authentication: its admin links it to Orchester Cloud, or pins Orchester Cloud's root key on the server (orchester-server cloud pin).
connect.unprovenServer: This server didn't prove it is the server it says it is on this connection, so your sign-in wasn't shown to it and the code wasn't sent. Connect to it over HTTPS; if a proxy holds its certificate, its admin sets that certificate's fingerprint on the server (proxy_certificate).
connect.accountExists: Your Orchester Cloud account already has an account on this server. Join with that account instead: with a code from one of its computers, or an account code from an admin. The invite code is still open.

link.taskListDescription: {{project}}'s tasks are only on this computer, with the key {{key}}. Link it to a project on your team's server to work on one task list with others.
link.serverDescription: A team server this computer is connected to.
link.noServer: This computer isn't connected to a team server yet.
link.projectDescription: Projects on {{server}} you're a member of. An empty one takes {{project}}'s {{count}} tasks with their numbers; one with tasks opens the join review first.
link.noProjects: You aren't a member of a project there yet.
link.linkedElsewhere: linked to another checkout on this computer
link.addressInvalid: That isn't a project address: the server's address, then the project's slug.
link.repositoryDescription: Compared with the project's repository hint before anything is sent.

remote.different: This checkout's origin is {{origin}}; {{project}} was set up for {{hint}}.
remote.noOrigin: This checkout has no origin remote
remote.noOriginHint: Orchester can't compare it with {{project}}'s hint, {{hint}}. You can still link it.
remote.noOriginBody: Orchester can't compare it with a project's repository hint. You can still link it.
remote.noHint: The project names no repository; nothing to compare.
remote.choose: Choose a project to compare its repository hint.

link.chooseFirst: Choose a project or type its address first
link.hint: Shows what goes up before anything is sent.

mismatch.title: This checkout's origin is {{origin}}
mismatch.body: {{project}} on {{server}} was set up for {{hint}}. Link it only if this checkout really holds {{project}}'s code; nothing is checked beyond this.

notConnected.title: {{host}} isn't connected
notConnected.body: Connect this computer to {{host}} first; then link this project. Nothing was sent to it.

link.noProject: There's no project you're a member of at {{address}}. Check the address with whoever sent it, or ask one of its owners for an invite. Orchester sends nothing.

discovery.title: orchester.toml names a project
discovery.body: {{address}}. Orchester hasn't contacted it. Use this address?

link.noProjectYet: No project for this yet? Projects are created in {{server}}'s server admin, by name and slug, by an admin. Open {{host}} in your browser.
link.noProjectYetAny: No project for this yet? Projects are created in a team server's admin, by name and slug, by an admin.

sends.title: What linking sends
sends.sharedValue: Tasks (title, brief, criteria, organization, status), who holds each, short run progress, published configuration
sends.staysValue: Runs, worktrees, conversations, memory, secrets, connections, accounts
sends.never: The server never receives transcripts, prompts, diffs, file or branch names, code or secrets.

unconnected.title: orchester.toml names a project on a server this computer isn't connected to
unconnected.titleServer: orchester.toml names a server this computer isn't connected to
unconnected.body: The file at the repository root points to {{address}}. Orchester hasn't contacted it: anyone who can push to the repository can change the file, so each step asks you first.
unconnected.connectStep: Connect this computer to {{host}}: you compare its check code before anything is sent
unconnected.linkStep: Link {{local}} to its project {{slug}} there, after Orchester shows what goes up
unconnected.chooseStep: Choose your project there and link {{local}} to it, after Orchester shows what goes up

notMember.title: {{server}} has no project you're a member of at this address
notMember.body: Either there's no project at {{address}}, or you aren't a member of it: the server answers both alike. Ask whoever shared the address for an invite, or an owner to add your username, then check again. Nothing was uploaded.
notMember.ownersUnknown: Not known: a server names a project's owners only to its members
notMember.note: Orchester only asked {{server}} for the project at this address; it sent nothing else.

linked.taskListDescription: {{local}}'s tasks live in {{project}} on {{server}}; every member's computer keeps a copy and keeps working offline. Runs stay on the computer that runs them.
linked.addressDescription: The project this checkout is linked to. Its address is its identity and never changes.
linked.noAddress: Not read from the server yet

repository.description: {{project}} on {{server}} was set up for this remote. Orchester compares it with this checkout's origin.
repository.different: This checkout's origin is {{origin}} · it doesn't match · checked {{time}}
repository.noOrigin: This checkout has no origin remote; nothing to compare.
repository.nothingToCompare: The project names no repository; nothing to compare.
repository.unread: {{server}} can't be reached now; the hint is compared once it can.
repository.unknownServer: The project's server is no longer in Settings › Orchester.
repository.notListed: The server no longer lists this project for you.

linked.notLinked: This project isn't linked to a server project.

removed.title: You're no longer a member of {{project}}
removed.body: {{server}} answered at {{time}} that you aren't in {{project}} any more. This computer keeps {{key}}'s {{count}} tasks as they were then, read-only. Make {{local}} local to keep working here, or ask an owner to add {{username}} again.
removed.bodyNoName: {{server}} answered at {{time}} that you aren't in {{project}} any more. This computer keeps {{key}}'s {{count}} tasks as they were then, read-only. Make {{local}} local to keep working here, or ask an owner to add you again.
removed.detail: {{key}} · joined {{day}} · you were a member · last synced {{synced}}

linked.makeLocalDescription: Stop using the server on this computer. Every task becomes a local task of {{project}} here; {{key}} stays the same for everyone else.
linked.leaveDescription: Stop being a member. This computer keeps a local copy of the tasks and stays connected to {{server}} for your other projects.
linked.leaveDescriptionNoServer: Stop being a member. Leaving is done on {{server}}, which this computer isn't connected to now; Make local works without it.
linked.leaveNoServer: Leave works once this computer is signed in to {{server}} again.
linked.leaveOffline: {{server}} can't be reached now; Leave works when it's back.
linked.leaveBody: You stop being a member of {{project}} on {{server}}. Its tasks stay here as they are, read-only; an owner can invite you again.
linked.leaveHint: You stop being a member; the project stays on the server for the team
linked.makeLocalHint: Keeps a copy of its tasks here; the server's stay for the team

upload.title: Link {{local}} to {{address}}?
upload.lead: Uploads {{local}}'s {{count}} tasks to {{project}} on {{server}} in one step, with their numbers. Every member of {{project}} sees them from then on.
upload.leadEmpty: {{local}} has no tasks yet, so nothing goes up: {{project}} on {{server}} starts empty, and new tasks are numbered there.
upload.leadDownload: {{project}} on {{server}} has {{count}} tasks; they come down to this computer as they are. {{local}} has no tasks of its own to upload.
upload.changed: {{local}}'s tasks changed since this page opened
upload.changedBody: A task was added or removed meanwhile, so nothing was sent and {{local}} is still local. Review again reads what linking it to {{project}} does now.
upload.foreignAddress: The server names this project at {{own}}, not at the address this computer connected to, so Orchester didn't use it and nothing was sent. If {{own}} is how your team reaches the server, connect to it by that address.
upload.taken: The project got tasks of its own meanwhile, so linking this checkout is a join, reviewed first. Nothing was sent: Cancel, then link again to open the join review.
upload.nextValue: Continue at {{key}}, numbered by the server
upload.claimsValue: {{keys}} · a run of each hasn't ended
upload.noClaims: None: no run is under way
upload.serverTasksValue: {{count}} · with the numbers they have on {{server}}
upload.noneHere: None on this computer, so nothing goes up

discovery.description: Adds project = "{{address}}" at the repository root, so colleagues who open this checkout are offered to link it. Orchester doesn't commit it; you do.
discovery.other: orchester.toml names something else; Orchester leaves it as it is.

upload.nothingYet: Nothing is sent until you choose {{action}}. Cancel returns to Sharing with {{local}} still local.
upload.nothingYetChanged: Nothing is sent: Review again reads what linking does now, on a page you confirm again. Cancel returns to Sharing with {{local}} still local.

members.unread: The members can't be read until {{server}} answers.
members.intro: Members of {{project}} on {{server}}, as of {{time}}, read-only here. Owners and admins manage members, roles and invites in the server admin.
members.introMember: Members of {{project}} on {{server}}. To add someone, ask an owner: {{owners}}.
members.introOffline: Members as of {{time}}, when {{server}} was last reached. Manage opens when it's back.
members.introOfflineMember: Members as of {{time}}, when {{server}} was last reached. To add someone, ask an owner: {{owners}}.
members.introNoServer: Members as of {{time}}, as last read. This computer isn't signed in to {{server}} now, so the list doesn't change until it joins again.
members.manageOffline: {{server}} can't be reached now; the server admin opens when it's back.
members.manageNoServer: This computer isn't signed in to {{server}} now; the server admin opens once it joins again.
members.manageNoAddress: Opens once the project's address has been read from {{server}}.
members.manageForeign: {{server}} names this project at {{address}}, on {{own}} rather than the address this computer connected to, so Orchester doesn't open it. If {{own}} is how your team reaches {{server}}, connect to it by that address.
members.manageNote: Manage members and invites opens {{url}} in your browser, where owners and admins sign in with their Orchester account.
members.openFailed: The browser didn't open {{url}}. Open it yourself.
members.name: NAME
members.introRemoved: Members of {{project}} as of {{time}}, the last time you were one of them. {{server}} shows its members only to members, so this list no longer changes.
members.comeBack: To come back, ask an owner, {{owners}}, to add {{username}} in {{server}}'s server admin; Check again looks at once, and Orchester also checks every minute.
members.comeBackNoName: To come back, ask an owner, {{owners}}, to add you again in {{server}}'s server admin; Check again looks at once, and Orchester also checks every minute.

makeLocal.reading: Reading what making it local changes…
makeLocal.title: Make {{local}} local on this computer?
makeLocal.body: {{local}} stops using {{server}} here. Nothing changes for the other members of {{key}}; you can join again later.
makeLocal.bodyUnreachable: {{server}} can't be reached, so your claims can't be released now. They go stale on their own 15 minutes after their last heartbeat, and others can then take them over.
makeLocal.bodyRemoved: You're no longer a member of {{key}}, so nothing is released there. {{local}} keeps its tasks as they were last synced at {{time}}.
makeLocal.bodySignedOut: This computer isn't signed in to the project's server, so it can't tell which claims are yours or release them. Any you hold go stale on their own 15 minutes after their last heartbeat, and others can then take them over.
makeLocal.tasks: All {{count}} stay as local tasks with their numbers
makeLocal.tasksAsSynced: All {{count}} stay as local tasks · as last synced at {{time}}
makeLocal.organization: Kept as they were last synced · {{key}}'s tags become {{local}}'s local tags
makeLocal.claimsUnknown: Unknown here · any you hold go stale
makeLocal.notShared: {{count}} return to the list with numbers after the highest
makeLocal.notMember: You're no longer a member of {{key}}

made.title: {{local}} is local on this computer
made.body: Its {{count}} tasks are local tasks now, with their numbers.
made.stale: {{body}} The claims on {{keys}} weren't released after all: the server didn't take it, so they go stale on their own.
made.returned: {{body}} The tasks kept Not shared returned: {{moved}}.

discovery.label: Discovery file
discovery.description: orchester.toml at the repository root names {{local}}'s address, so a colleague opening this checkout is offered to link it.
discovery.notCommitted: Not committed yet: commit it so colleagues get it
discovery.commitUnknown: git can't say whether it's committed
discovery.writeFailed: orchester.toml couldn't be written; nothing was changed in the repository.
discovery.other: orchester.toml names another project or server; Orchester leaves it as it is.
discovery.noAddress: The project's address hasn't been read from its server yet, so there's nothing to write.
discovery.noServer: Unavailable while the project's server isn't in Settings › Orchester: Orchester checks the address against that server before writing it.
discovery.foreignAddress: {{server}} names this project at {{own}}, not at the address this computer connected to, so Orchester doesn't write it. If {{own}} is how your team reaches {{server}}, connect to it by that address.
discovery.invalidAddress: {{server}} answered with a project address Orchester can't read, so Orchester doesn't write it.

join.title: Join {{key}} on {{server}}

description.one: Your local task, ticked to start. Ticked, it is uploaded with a new {{key}} number and keeps its runs here. Untick it if {{key}} already has it: it stays on this computer as Not shared.
description.other: Your {{count}} local tasks, all ticked to start. Ticked tasks are uploaded with new {{key}} numbers and keep their runs here. Untick the ones {{key}} already has: they stay on this computer as Not shared.

join.loading: Reading your tasks and the server's…
join.noServer: This computer isn't connected to that server any more. Connect to it again in Settings › Orchester, then open the invite again.
join.noProject: There's no project you're a member of at that address. Nothing was sent or uploaded; ask whoever shared it for an invite.
join.locked: Can't be unticked: run {{number}} hasn't ended. Work on a shared task needs a claim, so it is uploaded claimed for you.
join.note: Similar titles are only a hint; nothing is merged. Status, priority, tags and links go with each task: tags match {{key}}'s tags by name (new names become {{key}} tags), and a link to a task that stays here is dropped. Runs, conversations and memory stay attached, and run branches keep their names.

sends.title: What joining sends
sends.sharedValue: The tasks you keep ticked: title, brief, criteria, pipeline name, limits, status

join.failedNothing: Nothing was uploaded and {{project}} is still local. Your ticks are kept; try again when {{server}} can be reached.
join.failedUploaded: Your tasks reached {{server}}, but this computer couldn't finish joining. Your ticks are kept; trying again links them without uploading them twice.
join.failedUnknown: {{project}} is still local. The connection was lost while your tasks were sent, so some may have reached {{server}}; trying again doesn't upload them twice.
join.linkedElsewhere: This checkout is linked to another project already, so nothing was read or sent. A checkout links to one project: make it local first in its Sharing to join this one.

joined.heading: You joined {{key}} on {{server}}
joined.detail: {{uploaded}} tasks were uploaded with new numbers and {{claimed}} claimed for you; {{kept}} stay on this computer as Not shared. The project's key is now {{key}}. Searching the task list for a former key still finds the task.
joined.dropped: Links to tasks that stay here were dropped: {{links}}.

mapping.heading: Keys before joining
mapping.detail: Your local tasks got {{key}} numbers when you joined. Orchester doesn't rewrite text, so a brief or message that says {{before}} means {{now}}; each task's page shows was {{before}}.
mapping.detailNone: None of your local tasks was uploaded when you joined: they stay on this computer as Not shared until you share them.
mapping.notSharedNote: read-only · Share task on its page
mapping.branches: Run branches keep the names they started with. The next run of a task is named by its new key.

landing.title: Join {{project}} on {{server}}
landing.lead: This computer is connected to {{server}} as {{username}}. Pick the checkout of {{project}} here; the next page shows what joining does before anything is sent.
landing.reading: Reading the project and your checkouts…
landing.loadFailed: The invite's project can't be read
landing.noHint: None: the project names no repository
landing.noOrigin: No origin remote: Orchester can't compare it with the project's hint
landing.nothingToCompare: The project names no repository; nothing to compare
landing.tasks: {{count}} local tasks, {{first}} … {{last}}. You choose which go up on the next page.
landing.oneTask: 1 local task, {{key}}. You choose whether it goes up on the next page.
landing.noTasks: A local project with no tasks yet: the review only shows what {{project}} brings.
landing.differsNote: You can still pick it; the warning stays visible in Sharing.
landing.linkedNote: A checkout links to one project. To link it here, make {{project}} local first in its Sharing; its tasks stay with it.
landing.noCheckoutAny: No local project here can be linked to it yet
landing.noCheckoutBody: Clone it where you keep your code, then add that folder. Orchester never clones for you: the server holds tasks, not code. Continue to the join review stays unavailable until a checkout is picked.
landing.addHint: For a folder Orchester doesn't know yet. Not cloned? Clone {{hint}} yourself first: the server never holds code.
landing.notGit: {{path}} can't be linked: Orchester needs a git checkout of {{hint}}, and there's no .git folder there. Pick the folder you cloned.
landing.notAdded: {{path}} couldn't be added. The reason is in Orchester's log; pick another folder.
landing.notGitLine: Not a git checkout: there's no .git folder here
landing.notGitNote: A downloaded archive can't run agents' branches and worktrees. Pick the folder you cloned.
landing.addedNote: Adds it to All projects as it is; Orchester keeps its own data there and changes nothing else in the folder.
landing.addFirst: Continue to the join review stays unavailable until a checkout is picked.

waits.title: {{project}} waits in Settings › Orchester
waits.body: You're a member of {{project}} on {{server}}; nothing is linked or uploaded yet. {{server}} in Settings › Orchester lists {{project}} with Link a checkout…, which brings you back here.

share.title: Share {{project}} on a team server
share.lead: Its tasks move to the server; teammates see and run them. Runs, worktrees and settings stay on each computer.
share.addressHint: Or the address of a project you are a member of
share.onServerHint: Its tasks move to the server; teammates see and run them

team.title: Team server
team.refused: What a shared project can't do yet
team.refusedFields: Task fields the server doesn't keep
team.refusedFieldsHint: Delivers, Don't merge automatically · the server refuses a change rather than lose it
team.refusedFieldsInfo: A shared project's server keeps neither what a task's runs deliver nor Don't merge automatically. Setting either on a task of this project is refused rather than lost, so the Orchestrator never merges or completes a task on its own that you believe opted out or set otherwise.
